{{Quote|It's an alpha species, native to my home planet.|Waleed Nagma describes the Syrox|<ref name="The Syrox Redemption">{{InsiderCite|146|The Syrox Redemption}}</ref>}}
'''Syrox''', also known as the '''Wolf Worms of Monsolar''', were an alpha [[Species/Legends|species]] of ectomorphic [[Worm/Legends|worm]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Monsolar/Legends|Monsolar]]. They lacked a [[Brain/Legends|brain]], yet were highly efficient predators which fed on blood using their large circular mouth of sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Syrox were [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] for the earliest stages of their life cycle, with Syrox females laying their microscopic eggs into the rivers of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], where they were consumed by other animals. These animals would become hosts for the juvenile worms, which would slowly incubate and grow within them for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. They would eventually emerge from their host, with adults having grown hugely in size. The worms could be coaxed out of their hosts by the smell of [[Anzati snot garlic]], and a folk remedy on Monsolar said if a host placed a bulb of garlic on their [[Pillow/Legends|pillow]] while they slept the Syrox would crawl out of their mouth. [[Waleed Nagma]], a native of Monsolar, became infested by a Syrox prior to being incarcerated in [[Cog Hive Seven]]. Whilst in the prison he had some garlic smuggled in and drew the creature out, after which it was killed.

Another Syrox had incubated within Nagma's body and it emerged from his corpse shortly after his death, whilst it was still small enough to go unnoticed. The creature went on to reside within the pipes that surrounded the prison, growing to large proportions and feeding on prisoners that it encountered. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the worm consumed the prisoners [[Vasco Nailhead|Vas Nailhead]] and [[Strabo]] after they entered the pipes in pursuit of the prison officer [[Augustine Smight]].<ref name="Lockdown" />
